summary: This video previews the September 1 update adjustments for the Cloudtop Arbor Hydra in Temporal Vortex, which nerfs boss difficulty, tweaks summoned units, and adjusts unbroken damage scaling. Skratch tests an Ice Blast composition against the boss, showing that survivability is the primary issue when using Oggok compared to Anselmo. With Anselmo's damage blocking, the Ice Blast team reaches over 3.1 billion damage even at lower inspiration levels. While high-investment Ice Blast can potentially reach massive numbers (up to 22 billion on Chinese servers), high-end Toxin teams currently dominate with 13 to 17+ billion damage.

heroes.name: Anselmo
heroes.verdict: Essential support for Ice Blast survival
heroes.note: Provides complete damage blocking and Attack Penalty that allows the Ice Blast team to survive the Hydra's high damage stacks until the end.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.note: Cannot generate enough shielding or sustain to keep the Ice Blast squad alive against the boss's rapid damage scaling.

heroes.name: Ernesto
heroes.verdict: Solid frontliner but prone to dying early
heroes.note: Requires defensive gearing, Angelic Alliance, and healing talents like Recreate to survive the Hydra's assault.

heroes.name: Stegamoffyn
heroes.verdict: Surprising top pick in Toxin teams
heroes.note: Referred to as the 'blueberry muffin,' he provides consistent survivability and utility that lets the Toxin team easily surpass 13 billion damage.

heroes.name: Beldelle
heroes.note: Outputs immense damage in Ice Blast teams, reaching top-tier numbers when backed by inspirations.

heroes.name: Fredegonda
heroes.note: Scales tremendously with Inspiration levels 2 and 5 to skyrocket teamwide Ice Blast burst.

heroes.name: Shinnah
heroes.note: Crucial element for Ice Blast generation and maintaining damage consistency.

teams.note: Ice Blast squad achieving 3.1B+ damage. Anselmo is vital over Oggok to mitigate boss burst; Ernesto uses defensive gear with Angelic Alliance.
Top-performing Toxin lineup capable of dealing 13B to 17.5B+ damage, heavily reliant on Serpentemis and Stegamoffyn's sustain.

meta_changes: Temporal Vortex Cloudtop Arbor Hydra difficulty reduced on the Sunlit Side (Diurna).
Hydra Shaded Side (Nocturna) summoned serpent egg HP increased, with adjusted summoning rules and counts.
Adjusted the number of times Arbor Hydra must remain unbroken before gaining additional damage bonus stacks.
tips: Run Anselmo over Oggok if your Ice Blast team is wiping prematurely in Cloudtop Arbor Hydra.
Switch Ernesto's talent to Recreate (heals HP when an Ice Crystal is consumed) and equip Angelic Alliance to prevent early deaths.
Stegamoffyn provides outstanding stability in Toxin teams without significantly sacrificing total output.
title: Is The Ice Blast Team Strong Enough?? Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
